answer: Use reciprocal mirror audits: each epoch every identity is randomly paired with a peer whose recent work it must independently reproduce and check, staking a small bond on the verdict. A Sybil ring can only mirror its own clones, so random cross-pairing exposes it like a comet crossing a dark sky, the fraud visible to outsiders. Passing a fake audit slashes the auditor bond too, so each fake identity costs the attacker real stake plus the compute of faked work, while zephyr-light gossip spreads each verdict network-wide before the next epoch.
